note: How the game feeds its sound (src/audio/index.js, src/audio/game-state.js, src/world/sound-near.js; docs 17 and 25). updateHz: how often the sound state is built and the ambience updated (doc 17: 10 Hz). near: what is close to the camera target, sampled every nearEveryS seconds over a circle of radiusM (doc 17: within 12 m), cell by cell (the water summary's half-meter cells, the growth grid's one-meter cells), each cell weighted by closeness (1 at the center, falloff at the edge). Water kinds come from the water summary's classes: still is pond water, slow and running are streams. Ponds count by their share of the circle; streams are thin, so slow and running count by how close the nearest stream cell is: full within streamFullM, easing to none at radiusM. Cells beyond the summary are open sea; the sea counts toward nearWater for the rain on open water, but not toward the pond lap. fullAt is the share of weighted points that counts as fully near (so a pond filling a third of the circle already sounds like a pond). Pads and reeds count plants within plantReachM of each point, each species at its weight in pads and reeds (lilies make pads; reeds, and irises at half, make reeds); the rush cover counts as reeds at rushWeight. grass: the grass cover (0..255) that counts as full grass. gust: the wind's gusts, which the weather does not keep, made here on a seeded rhythm: a gust comes every everyS seconds (shorter as wind rises, divided by everyWindScale plus the wind), rises to a peak between peak[0] and peak[1] scaled up by the wind, lasts holdS, and the level follows its target at followPerS. frost (doc 25): winter mornings are frosty until the sun burns it off. frost = the winter weight, times a curve of hours from sunrise (byHourFromSunrise, flat past the ends), times 1 - cloudCut * cloud, and none while it rains. afterRainH: game hours of drips after rain stops (doc 25 asks for one to two). frogs: the frog agents decide who calls and when (src/world/creatures/agents.js, with the 0.4 s answering rule and the hush after a startle, doc 23); the sound reads their new calls and plops every pollS seconds and starts each leadS seconds ahead on the audio clock, as the throat starts to swell. A call or plop older than staleS (after a hidden tab, say) is let go rather than played late. A call's intensity goes from intensityFromMood[0] for an unsettled frog (mood 0) to [1] for a content one. plop: the bubble size (cm) and level range of a frog going into the water (doc 25 frog body sounds), placed where it went in. When a frog calls within duckNearM of the camera, the music dips by mixer.json duck.db and comes back duckHoldS after the last such call (doc 24, finding a frog by ear). music: the director decides updateHz times a second (doc 24: 2 Hz). mobile: a phone is a coarse pointer with a short screen side under phoneMaxSidePx (the audio check page uses the same rule). seed: the sub-seed for this system's streams.
